## Decision C answered · 2026-10-15

Maintainer, in the epic PM session on 2026-10-15, verbatim:

> A、B、C 三项全按设计稿裁定：权限进导航、More 退役；Advanced 扁平成七个标签；权限页改五个标签。记到专题卡上。

Decision C is the third clause: the Access content column becomes five tabs (Objects as the landing, System capabilities, Row-level security, Tab visibility, Delegated admin), not one scrolling page with anchors. The Target section's item 3 stands as written; its "if the maintainer keeps the single page" branch is void. The full record, with the premise to re-check (the five sections still render as one stacked column), is on the epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446. This card stays blocked on #12459 (objectstack-ai/objectui#12460, enqueued).

<sub>Written 2026-10-15T09:12Z by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff`.</sub>

Unlock read 2026-10-15T09:52Z: #12459 landed in objectstack-ai/objectui#12460 (main `cf430cd10e`), so the Blocked-by line that names it is satisfied. The reference artboards are on main under `docs/design/studio-redesign/` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12458) and the body now carries a Reference artboard section naming this card's.

Claimable by the `domain:ui` lane inside the epic's reservation, as #12450, #12452 and #12454 were claimed by seat `domain:ui#4` at 09:35Z; acceptance against the artboard stays with the epic PM.
